intent: I've been using a budget phone with an LCD for years, and my friend keeps shoving her flagship in my face saying the screen alone is worth the extra money. Every display looks shiny in a store demo. Is there a real, explainable difference in how the expensive screens work, and does it matter for someone who mostly reads, messages, and watches the occasional video outdoors? More importantly, where does the improvement stop? Is there a middle tier where I get most of the screen for half the cash? Give me the price point past which I'd just be paying for bragging rights.
